card.name: Words just before flo-/bloom- words
card.fires_on: Fires on the word or number right before an expected word starting with flo or blo, such as flores, flooding, floxuridine, flood or Bloom's. It predicts that such a word comes next.

modes.label: Spanish counts before flores
modes.description: A number in a Spanish count of hummingbirds, flowers and visits, just before the word flores.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward word starts like flo and blo, and away from them in some forms; the output tokens are mostly odd fragments.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before a flower, flood, floxuridine or Bloom term is about to appear.
